title: Kad ja pođoh na Bembašu
description: “When I set out for Bembaša,” a traditional sevdalinka about walking out to Bembaša, a spot by the river at the eastern edge of old Sarajevo. Himzo Polovina, a Sarajevo doctor and singer, made it famous.

title: Boléro
description: Ravel’s piece of one slowly building melody. Torvill and Dean skated to a shortened version at the 1984 Sarajevo Olympics, which made it the music Britain still connects with the city.

title: Lipe cvatu
description: “The Linden Trees Are Blooming,” a ballad by Bijelo Dugme, the Sarajevo band that was Yugoslavia’s biggest rock group in the 1970s and 1980s.

title: The Cellist of Sarajevo
description: A piece for solo cello written by the English pianist David Wilde in 1992, after he read about Vedran Smailović playing in the street during the siege. Yo-Yo Ma has played and recorded it.

title: Miss Sarajevo
description: A song by U2 and Brian Eno, recording as Passengers, with Luciano Pavarotti singing in Italian. It was inspired by the beauty contest held in besieged Sarajevo and Bill Carter’s film about it.
